item.title: Version 1.5.38
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.38 Update

  • ✨ Enhanced Inline AI Experience
    - Selected text is now clearly displayed at the top of your message.
    - Dynamic Selection Sync: Selecting different text during a conversation instantly updates the referenced text in your message bubble.
  • 🔧 Improved Selection Detection
    - Generic Web Apps: Fixed an issue where text selection was not recognized on certain websites (e.g. Reddit) due to limited Accessibility API support.
